title: Add player controls, isometric camera, and reset
acceptance: desktop keyboard controls map through the action-input layer to steering, throttle, braking/reverse, handbrake, and reset without physics code reading DOM keys directly
a near-isometric follow camera uses stable pitch/yaw and smoothing with enough look-ahead to read upcoming streets at driving speed
camera behavior remains readable through normal drift yaw and does not snap unpredictably when the car rotates quickly
reset finds or uses a safe nearby road pose and restores an overturned, stuck, fallen, or undrivable car without requiring a page reload
the browser can launch directly into free driving with the required controls and no mission/progression dependency
